coverage_original.instructions: Use state.cv and the skill items in state.question_args.skill_coverage.items. How many supplied items are explicitly mentioned or unambiguously described? Each item's name and aliases refer to the same item; count that item once. Basic exposure or a skills-list mention counts. Do not infer a specific item solely from a broader or related activity. This is document coverage, not proficiency.

criteria.0: Exactly 0 of the supplied items are evidenced.
criteria.1: Exactly 1 of the supplied items are evidenced.
criteria.2: Exactly 2 of the supplied items are evidenced.
criteria.3: Exactly 3 of the supplied items are evidenced.
criteria.4: Exactly 4 of the supplied items are evidenced.

coverage_revised.instructions: Use state.cv and state.question_args.skill_coverage.items. Match each supplied item separately to explicit mentions or unambiguous descriptions in the CV, then choose the number of matched list items. An item's name and aliases identify one item, not extra items. A generic category does not establish a particular product, brand, method or subtype. Related duties or likely tool use are insufficient. Basic exposure and list-only mentions count when they identify the supplied item. Count each matched item once; do not count CV mentions or inferred items. This is document coverage, not proficiency.

criteria.0: Exactly 0 of the supplied items are evidenced.
criteria.1: Exactly 1 of the supplied items are evidenced.
criteria.2: Exactly 2 of the supplied items are evidenced.
criteria.3: Exactly 3 of the supplied items are evidenced.
criteria.4: Exactly 4 of the supplied items are evidenced.

skill_evidence_excel.instructions: Use state.cv and the ONE skill identified by state.question_args.skill_evidence_excel.name and its aliases. Choose its strongest explicit evidence context, not ability. A tools-list mention alone does not establish application or professional use. Do not infer the named skill solely from a related activity or proximity to employment history.

criteria.not_mentioned: No identifiable mention or unambiguous description of the named skill.
criteria.stated_or_studied: The skill is listed, claimed or studied, without a concrete application example.
criteria.applied: The skill is explicitly used in a concrete nonprofessional project, practical training, volunteering or other nonprofessional activity; no explicit professional use.
criteria.used_professionally: The CV explicitly links the skill's use to professional work.
